deep.reconstruction:
The page is a short programmatic note that follows the previous page. There, for operators between Hilbert spaces E and F, Grothendieck characterised the trace-class ('Fredholm') operators L^1(E,F) by the summability of the singular numbers f_i(u), with ||u||_1 = sum f_i(u). He also proved that sum_{i<=n} f_i(u) = sup |Tr(vu)| over contractions v of rank at most n. From this he deduced the subadditivity sum_{i<=n} f_i(u+v) <= sum_{i<=n} (f_i(u)+f_i(v)), which is Ky Fan's inequality, i.e. weak majorization of the singular numbers.

This page announces 'Les definitions de L^p(E,F) et de || ||_p': the operators whose singular-number sequence lies in l^p. It gives ||u||_p = (sum_i lambda_i(u)^p)^{1/p} together with the unnormalised functional S_p(u) = sum_i lambda_i(u)^p. He adds that one checks the same results hold, the endpoint cases p = +infinity and p = 1 having been treated already. Here L^infinity means the compact operators (or all bounded ones) with the operator norm, and L^1 the trace class.

These are the Schatten-von Neumann classes. The natural route to the triangle inequality, implicit from the previous page, is: the Ky Fan inequality gives s(u+v) weakly majorized by s(u)+s(v); for p >= 1 this implies ||s(u+v)||_p <= ||s(u)+s(v)||_p <= ||u||_p + ||v||_p. The next page turns to duality: the dual of L_0 (compact operators) is L^1 via (u,v) = Tr(vu), presumably to be followed by the dual of L^p being L^q.

The purpose is to set up the operator ideals on Hilbert space as background for the tensor-norm and nuclear-operator theory of 1953.
errors: No errors, but there are gaps. The range of p is not specified; for 0<p<1, ||.||_p is only a quasi-norm, so 'the same results' (the triangle inequality, duality with p') hold only for 1<=p<=infinity.
The verification is only asserted, not carried out.

ideas.what: Classes L^p(E,F) of operators between Hilbert spaces with singular numbers in l^p, normed by the l^p-norm of the singular numbers.
ideas.usually_credited_to: R. Schatten and J. von Neumann (1946-1948); Schatten, 'A theory of cross-spaces' (1950)
ideas.where_published: Possibly mentioned in Produits tensoriels topologiques et espaces nucleaires (1955) or the Resume (1953) in connection with Hilbertian tensor norms; unsure

ideas.what: Deriving the p-norm triangle inequality from the Ky Fan partial-sum inequality established on the previous page.
ideas.modern_name: Weak majorization of singular values implies Minkowski for Schatten norms
ideas.usually_credited_to: Ky Fan (1951); standard in Gohberg-Krein and Simon

deep.surprise_reason: The page only records the standard definition of the Schatten p-classes and a remark that the earlier results extend. All of this was known (Schatten-von Neumann, Ky Fan) by 1953.
transcription_corrections: The singular numbers are written with the same symbol as on the previous page (it resembles f_i(u) / rho_i(u)), not explicitly lambda_i.
The last line is roughly 'qu'on verifie ... memes resultats ... [cas] p = +infinity, p = 1' — i.e. the endpoint cases already treated.
